summary: Puter is a web-based operating system built to provide an extensible desktop-like environment inside your browser. It facilitates file management and remote access capabilities through a unified interface. The project is implemented in Node.js and distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers and administrators looking to host a centralised web desktop for file organisation and remote access.
watchOut: The copyleft AGPL-3.0 licence requires you to make your source code available if you modify and network-host the application, which may not suit commercial deployments. Additionally, web-based operating systems can introduce significant security and sandboxing considerations.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy this via Docker, requiring persistent storage volumes for user data and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination. Since it runs on Node.js, you should allocate sufficient memory based on the expected concurrent browser sessions.
